arabic text: HAYE SAJJAD CHALAY SHAAM, KHUDA KHAIR KARAY
english translation text: OH SAJJAD (A.S.) IS ON HIS WAY TO SHAAM, MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: GALAY MAIN TAUQ HAY AUR BARIYAN HAIN PEARON MAIN.\nDIYA HAIN SHAAM KAY LOGO NAY YE INAAM, KHUDA KHAIR KARAY
english translation text: HE HAS A CUFF AROUND HIS NECK, HIS FEET ARE CHAINED,\nTHE PEOPLE OF SHAAM, HAVE GIVEN HIM THIS REWARD,\nMAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text:
WOH JIS KAY SAAR SAY RIDA BHI KABHI SARAK JAYE.
TO MARAY SHARAM KAY SURAJ WAHEEN PALAT JAYE.
SHARABIYON SAY HOWI HAY WOH HUM KALAM.
KHUDA KHAIR KARAY
english translation text:
IF THE VEIL JUST MOVED FROM THEIR HEAD SLIGHTLY,
THEN THE SUN WOULD FEEL EMBARRASSED AND SET FOR THEM,
SHE HAD TO FACE UP TO THE DRUNK MEN,
MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text:
TAMAM SHEARON KAY DEEVAR O DAR SAJAYE HAIN.
KHARI HAIN AURATAIN HAATON MAIN SANG UTHAYE HAIN.
KIYA HAY JASHAN-E-FATAH KA YE AHTAMAM.
KHUDA KHAIR KARAY.
english translation text:
ALL THE WALLS AND BOUNDARIES OF THE TOWN HAVE BEEN DECORATED,
THE LADIES ARE STANDING, CARRYING THEIR WEIGHTS IN THEIR HANDS,
THEY HAVE CELEBRATED THE END OF THEIR VICTORY,
MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: ALI KI BETI PAY GUZREEN QAYAMATEYN KITNI, DAYAAR E GHAIR MEI JHAYLEEN MUSIBATEYN KITNI,\nTABHI TO SHAAM MEI ROEY LAHU IMAM, KHUDA KHAIR KARAY
english translation text:
THE CALAMITIES THAT BEFELL THE DAUGHTERS OF ALI,
IN THE STRANGE LAND THEY BORE COUNTLESS DIFFICULTIES,
THEREFORE IN SHAAM, CRIED OUT THE BLOOD OF IMAM,
MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: BANAKE QAIDI AULADE ALI KO LAAYE HAI,\nYE SHOR BARPA HAI AAE HAI BAAGHI AAE HAI,\nMACHA HAI SHAAM KE LOGO ME KOHRAAM KHUDA KHAIR.
english translation text:
THEY HAVE BROUGHT THE CHILDREN OF ALI AS PRISONERS,
THERE WAS AN UPROAR, THE PRISONERS HAVE ARRIVED,
THERE WAS AN UPROAR AMIDST THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM,
MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: HASHR SE PEHLE IMAM E ZAMA JO AAYENGE\nALI KI TEGH BHI 'AKHTAR' WO SAATH LAAYENGE\nYAZEEDIYO SE WOH LENGE JO INTEQAM KHUDA KHAIR KARE
english translation text:
BEFORE THE END, WHEN IMAM ZAMANA REAPPEARS,
HE WILL BRING THE SWORD OF ALI WITH HIM,
HE WILL AVENGE THE KILLINGS BY YAZID,
MAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: BAZAR E SHAAM ME ZAINAB JO BERIDA HAI KHADI,\nBIMAARE SAYYEDE ABID PE KYA KATHAN HAI GHADI,\nBHARE BAZAAR ME HARSU HAI MAJMA E AAM KHUDA KHAIR.
english translation text:
IN THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM, ZAINAB IS STANDING WITHOUT A VEIL,
THIS IS SUCH A DIFFICULT MOMENT FOR THE ONE WHO WAS UNWELL (IMAM SAJJAD),
THE BAZAAR IS FULL OF PEOPLE,
MAKE ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: JANABE GHAZI KA SAR NAIZE PE TADAPTA THA,\nBIMAR QAIDI KI ANKHO SE KHUN BARASTA THA,\nLAEEN LETA THA ZAINAB KA JAB BHI NAAM KHUDA KHAIR.
english translation text: THE HEAD OF GHAZI (HAZRAT ABBAS) TREMBLES ON THE SPEAR,\nIMAM SAJJAD SHED TEARS OF BLOOD, WHEN THE OPPRESSOR TAKES THE NAME ZAINAB,\nMAY ALLAH MAKE ALL WELL

arabic text: BANA KAY QAIDI AULAD-E-ALI KO LAYE HAIN. YE SHOR BARPA AAYE HAIN BAGHI AAYE HAIN. MACHA HAY SHAAM KAY LOGON MAIN KOHRAM.\nKHUDA KHAIR KARAY.
english translation text:
THEY HAVE BROUGHT THE CHILDREN OF ALI AS PRISONERS,
THIS UPROAR IS BECAUSE THE REBELS HAVE COME.
THERE IS CHAOS AMONG THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM,
MAY GOD PROTECT US.
